breach.summary: Major credit reporting agency Equifax experienced a breach exposing Social Security numbers, dates of birth, and credit card information for millions of US consumers and international customers.
Home Depot data breach exposed customer payment card information through compromised point-of-sale systems across thousands of retail locations.
Yahoo Mail experienced a massive breach affecting over 500 million user accounts with access to email contents and personal information.
Marriott International discovered unauthorized access to guest reservation data including names, addresses, and payment information across multiple hotel chains.
Financial institution Capital One suffered a major breach exposing credit card information, Social Security numbers, and banking details of millions of customers.
Retail giant Target's point-of-sale systems were compromised, exposing customer payment card data and personal information during holiday shopping season.
Title insurance company FirstAmerican exposed decades of real estate transaction data, mortgage information, and personal financial records.
Meta platforms experienced a data leak exposing Facebook user phone numbers, account IDs, and personal profile information.
Health insurance provider Anthem suffered a massive breach exposing healthcare records, Social Security numbers, and medical information of millions of members.
Sony experienced a ransomware attack exposing employee data, unreleased content, and corporate information across entertainment and electronics divisions.

cve.summary: Apache Struts remote code execution vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable systems.
Oracle WebLogic Server contains a critical remote code execution vulnerability in the deserialization component.
VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass allows unauthenticated remote code execution on virtualization infrastructure.
OpenSSL cryptographic library contains a buffer overflow vulnerability affecting SSL/TLS communications globally.
Adobe ColdFusion remote code execution vulnerability affects web application servers used in enterprise environments.
Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains arbitrary file upload vulnerability allowing remote code execution.
Zimbra Collaboration Suite pre-authentication RCE allows attackers to compromise email servers.
Atlassian Confluence unauthenticated remote code execution affects enterprise wiki deployments worldwide.
Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure VPN authentication bypass allows unauthenticated remote access to networks.
SAP NetWeaver Application Server contains critical vulnerability affecting enterprise resource planning systems.

threat.summary: Conti ransomware gang is one of the most prolific threat actors, targeting healthcare and critical infrastructure with double extortion tactics.
Russian SVR-linked Turla APT group targets NATO countries with advanced persistent campaigns against government networks.
Chinese state-sponsored Volt Typhoon targets US critical infrastructure with multi-year stealth campaigns positioning for disruptive attacks.
Royal is an emerging ransomware-as-a-service platform actively exploiting newly disclosed vulnerabilities.
Russian military GRU-linked Fancy Bear continues targeting NATO members with sophisticated social engineering and zero-day exploits.
Emotet banking trojan botnet distributes ransomware and other malware to millions of compromised systems globally.
North Korean state hackers continue stealing cryptocurrency and targeting financial institutions for regime revenue.
Evil Corp financial cybercrime gang is responsible for over $100 million in theft and operates ransomware operations.
Iranian IRGC-linked MuddyWater APT targets government and critical infrastructure across Middle East and beyond.
Evolution of Carbanak banking malware continues targeting financial institutions with point-of-sale compromises.

news.title: Executive Order on Artificial Intelligence Security
news.summary: President issues executive order requiring federal agencies and critical infrastructure to implement AI security standards and conduct risk assessments.

news.title: NIST Releases Cybersecurity Framework 2.0
news.summary: National Institute of Standards and Technology updates cybersecurity framework with new guidance on cloud security and supply chain risk management.

news.title: Critical Infrastructure Protection Legislation Passes
news.summary: Congress passes bipartisan legislation requiring utilities, water systems, and energy companies to implement minimum cybersecurity standards.

news.title: Zero Trust Architecture Adoption Mandate
news.summary: Office of Management and Budget mandates federal agencies adopt zero trust security architecture by 2028.

news.title: Quantum Computing Cryptography Standards
news.summary: NIST announces post-quantum cryptographic standards to prepare organizations for quantum computing threat to current encryption.

news.title: SEC Enforcement Actions on Cyber Breaches
news.summary: Securities and Exchange Commission takes enforcement action against companies for inadequate cybersecurity disclosure following breaches.

news.title: EU Cyber Diplomacy Initiatives
news.summary: European Union launches cyber diplomacy initiative targeting state-sponsored hackers with sanctions and attribution.

news.title: AI-Powered Threat Detection Advances
news.summary: Leading security vendors deploy machine learning models for real-time threat detection and response reducing dwell time.

news.title: Supply Chain Security Requirements Expand
news.summary: NIST expands supply chain security guidelines requiring vendors to provide software bill of materials and security assessments.

news.title: International Ransomware Taskforce Report
news.summary: FBI and Department of Justice release report on international ransomware taskforce activities and prosecutions.
